Tekuteku has heard about all your
exploits, mooo.

rows.label: tlk70000003_04_msg0002

As someone who once worked with you,
I'm very proud, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_04_msg0003

horizons even more so I won't lose to
you, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_04_msg0004

There's still so much in Alst that
Tekuteku doesn't know, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000003_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Tekuteku's dream is to eventually
visit every city in Alst, mo!
